regions.region: Table 1 header, catalyst/ligand/additive structures, entries 1-20, and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Twenty independent optimization experiments transcribed row-by-row. Common charges, 18 h, default 60 °C, 70 °C exceptions, NMR-yield basis, isolated-yield parentheses, and chiral-HPLC er basis were preserved. Entries 8 and 14 retain er as not determined.

Narrative cross-check of entries 1-20. The prose gives 95:5 er for entry 18 while the table gives 5:95; this is retained as an unresolved source-order conflict and linked to the repeated 3aa scope result.

unresolved: Complete structures/isomeric SMILES for several chiral organocatalysts and dense ligands are not asserted from the small source drawings.
The enantiomer ordering behind the 5:95 versus 95:5 entry-18 discrepancy is unresolved.

regions.region: Scheme 3 general arrow, 13 scope products, and isolated-yield footnote
regions.finding: Thirteen displayed outcomes inspected. 3aa is the same experiment as Table 1 entry 18 and is not duplicated; the other 12 are independent scope records. Product-specific isolated yields and er values are linked to their products. The unidentified 3ca side product is retained without invented identity or amount.
One 2.5 mmol scale-up experiment: 3aa, 630 mg (98%), 95:5 er under the displayed catalytic conditions.

regions.region: Scheme 4 postfunctionalization arrows a and b
regions.finding: Two separate derivatization experiments: reductive amination to 4aa and Henry reaction to 5aa. All arrow doses were structured; the 0 °C-to-rt operation retains an unresolved split of the combined 15 h.

Author-proposed Si-face/backside-attack stereochemical model, stored as proposed mechanism rather than an observed experiment. Page text reports S configuration for 3fa by X-ray and refers to the observed absolute configuration of 3aa.

Terminal C-allenes gave degradation; phenylacetaldehyde and di(alkyl)aldehydes did not react. These are retained in source_context because complete substrate-pair identities and measurement bases are not given.

unresolved: Exact isomeric SMILES for dense scope products other than 3aa were not asserted.
Measurement bases for Scheme 4 yields/product masses and the 5aa dr are absent from the supplied main-text pages.
Identity and amount of the 3ca side product are unreported.
Negative-scope statements do not define enough individual experimental combinations for separate specific records.
